title: Cubes and Cube Roots
summary: Cube numbers as stacks of unit cubes, cube roots by prime triples, and Ramanujan's number 1729.

ib.note: Cubes and cube roots are MYP 3 Number

objectives: I can calculate cube numbers and recognise perfect cubes.
I can find cube roots using prime factorisation.
I can describe patterns in cube numbers.
misconceptions: The cube of a negative number is positive.
A perfect square can't also be a perfect cube.
